topic: A Roadmap for Career Success: How to Set Your Course
title: A Roadmap for Career Success: How to Set Your Course
session_title: A Roadmap for Career Success: How to Set Your Course
abstract: Investing in your career development should be one of the key priorities as you contemplate and plan your professional future. This Career Development workshop will teach you how to create a highly effective resume, polish up your LinkedIn profile, interview with confidence, and how to build a lasting professional network.
